providers.suitability: Strong candidate for Danish historical data. Superliga, domestic cup, lower division and European sections must be kept separate and checked for coverage.
providers.access: Agreement required for systematic collection, larger datasets, automation or use in a service. The provider states that it may supply an appropriate data format.
providers.nextRequirement: A data-use agreement and export; confirm earliest seasons, competition coverage, assists coverage and website/mobile distribution.

providers.suitability: Documented JSON API with squads, player statistics, seasons and transfers. The public free-plan description includes Danish Superliga, but this does not verify full FCM historical coverage.
providers.access: Account/API token required. Historical access depends on subscription/add-on. Product display and storage are described as permitted; raw-data redistribution needs approval.
providers.nextRequirement: A user-owned account/token, confirmation of historical seasons and permission for the intended static frontend/mobile distribution. Check missing competitions and fields before computing club totals.

providers.suitability: Public coverage list includes Danish Superliga and DBU Pokalen. Per-season historical player coverage and transfer-fee completeness remain unverified.
providers.access: API access and intended storage/distribution rights need to be established before import.

providers.suitability: CC0 structured identity/linking data can support a candidate roster. Complete club appearances, goals, assists, transfer fees and season coverage have not been verified; do not use identity records as statistics verification.
providers.access: Published CC0 and documented data interfaces. Observe the published access/rate-limit guidelines.

providers.suitability: Official club announcements and match reports are suitable for targeted cross-checking. No complete, reusable 150-player statistical export was established during this review.
Rejected as a statistical source: the list states an old statistics cutoff and warns of unclear sourcing. No listed numbers were imported.

recommendation: Transfermarkt is the user-selected primary reference. No automated copying or search-index statistics import. Await directly reviewed data with documented reuse basis or a permitted export. API-Football is no longer the default workflow.
scopeDecision: Keep the existing all-official-competitions definition until an alternative dataset is actually verified. If only Superliga data is licensed, create and label a separate Superliga-only scope; never relabel it as all competitions.
